lines.text: Many learners say: I looked a movie last night.
Better: I watched a movie last night.
Watched! I watched a movie last night.

data.wrong: I looked a movie last night.
data.right: I watched a movie last night.
data.memory: I watched a movie last night.

native.hook: 映画は look で見る？
native.tip: 映画は watch を使います。look は「目を向ける」で、後ろに at が必要です。
native.caption: “I looked a movie last night.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語の「見る」はひとつなので、look と watch が混ざりがちです。“I watched a movie last night.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“watched”。“I watched a movie last night.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Use watch for a movie. Look needs at.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I looked a movie last night.” 😅 Japanese uses one word for see, look and watch. The natural way is “I watched a movie last night.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
